title: 1812 Prairie's third storey gets its arched windows
items: George H. Wheeler's house at 1812 Prairie now has the third storey Albert Levy's photograph shows: a broad arched window with a fanlight over the balcony and a smaller round-arched window beside it, each in a ring of stone voussoirs that runs up into the gable.
The front now rises straight into its shaped gable, with no eave or gutter across it, and the second storey's north window is one wide window on a stone mullion under a transom, as in the photograph.
